narratives.title: Geopolitical Escalation Driving Risk-Off
narratives.summary: Capital is fleeing risk assets as multi-front conflicts (US-Iran, Israel-Lebanon, Ukraine-Russia) escalate beyond controlled tit-for-tat. The shootdown of a US Apache and Iran's retaliation contradict the 'one-and-done' thesis, while equity break below key supports confirms panic selling.
narratives.trade_implication: Short S&P 500 futures (SPY) and long VIX; add long WTI crude oil positions as supply disruption risk is underpriced.

narratives.title: Oil Supply Disruption and Blockade
narratives.summary: The Strait of Hormuz blockade is structurally biting, with EIA projecting persistence through Q3 2026 and Kuwait seeking bypass pipelines. The US SPR release is misread as bearish but actually signals pre-positioning for sustained disruption, driving capital into oil and energy equities.
narratives.trade_implication: Long WTI crude oil futures and energy sector ETFs (XLE); short downstream refiners exposed to crude input costs.

narratives.title: Diplomatic Off-Ramp Uncertainty
narratives.summary: Despite active conflict, White House claims of 'progress' on Iran deal and US Ambassador's ceasefire signals create a diplomatic track that markets are underweighting. Capital is torn between pricing in escalation and potential de-escalation, leading to choppy positioning in safe havens and oil.
narratives.trade_implication: Hedge with long gold and short-term T-bills; avoid directional bets on oil until deal clarity emerges.
